stories.title: Anthropic's VS Code extension on Cursor was backdoored for nearly 12 hours
stories.take: Attackers got into Anthropic's verified Cursor account and shipped a tainted Claude extension to thousands of developer machines — flawed code in the malware is the only reason it didn't spread further.

stories.title: Cracks are emerging in the AI spending boom
stories.take: Mounting debt, negative cash flow and growing investor skepticism are starting to test Big Tech's billions-a-week AI infrastructure buildout.

stories.title: Nvidia weighs playing cosigner for Nscale's AI data center in West Virginia
stories.take: When AI lenders get nervous, it helps to have the chipmaker itself cosign the loan — Nvidia is considering exactly that for Nscale's West Virginia project.

stories.title: Intel's stock crashes, knocking $12B from the government's stake
stories.take: AI demand is gobbling the memory and components PCs need, PC prices are rising, and Intel — and the US government's stake in it — took the hit.

stories.title: Anthropic expected to receive a high 'junk' credit rating after its IPO
stories.take: A Blackstone forecast reported by the FT says Anthropic's massive spending could earn it a high junk rating, making its future borrowing pricier.

stories.title: NASA is once again asking for ideas to rescue Hubble from certain death
stories.take: Hubble's orbit keeps decaying and NASA is soliciting reboost ideas again — the same ask from four years ago that went nowhere.

stories.title: Salesforce's M&A spree continues with a reported $375M deal for defense startup Rune
stories.take: The AI logistics startup would bolster Salesforce's Missionforce defense platform as the CRM giant keeps buying its way into government work.

stories.title: DoorDash buying Instacart challenges Uber's $2 billion ad business
stories.take: Ad buyers say a combined DoorDash-Instacart retail media offering would be very hard for brands to ignore — and Uber's $2B ad business is the target.

stories.title: Amazon's Ads nears $20 billion in Q3 as it bets on agentic AI
stories.take: Amazon's ad business is closing on $20B a quarter; its new Ads Agent promises simpler buying but raises transparency questions.

stories.title: Amid growing tension over workplace AI, agencies have a window to reimagine staffing
stories.take: AI agents are now common inside agencies, but most firms still haven't grasped how much they could reshape teams — Digiday says that window is open now.

stories.title: GTA 6's latest gameplay reveal is filthy, and South Park is helping Rockstar sell it
stories.take: Rockstar let South Park carry part of the GTA 6 sell — Creative Bloq calls it the most entertaining bit of game marketing in a long time.

stories.title: How brands like Wendy's and Planet Fitness wove into the fabric of Bravo Fan Fest
stories.take: At Bravo Fan Fest in Charleston, Wendy's and Planet Fitness skipped the booth-and-banner routine and built themselves into the fan experience.

stories.title: The changing CMO role in 3 numbers
stories.take: More than a quarter of CMOs hired this year have AI skills, versus just 9% four years ago — the job is being rewritten in the hiring data.

stories.title: Sources: Walter and Kushner finalize terms of Lakers sale at $12.5B valuation
stories.take: Mark Walter and Thrive's Josh Kushner met Thursday to finalize the Lakers transaction at a $12.5B valuation, with a formal signing expected soon — closing a stunning 72-hour sale.

stories.title: Thunder say Chet Holmgren out 8-10 weeks after knee procedure
stories.take: OKC's injury pile-up gets worse: Holmgren joins Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace on the shelf for most of the next two months.

stories.title: 76ers beat Knicks 98-93 in NBA Cup play without Jaylen Brown
stories.take: Brown sat with a left patella injury, announced just before tip — and Philadelphia still won its NBA Cup game over New York, 98-93.

stories.title: Morant, hurt against the Grizzlies, to miss at least four weeks
stories.take: Ja Morant strained his left hamstring in his first game against his former team and Portland loses him for at least a month.

stories.title: NBA Cup 2026 tips off Friday night
stories.take: The fourth in-season tournament opens tonight — CBS's bold calls include a new champion, a record for futility and a surprising early exit.

stories.title: NBA's 'unprecedented' early-season injury crisis has players and coaches searching for answers
stories.take: Less than two weeks into the season, star after star is already down — Holmgren and Morant are just the latest names on a list the league can't explain.

stories.title: King and Gray among latest MLB free agents; Alcantara's option exercised
stories.take: Michael King and Sonny Gray headline 14 players who hit the market Friday, while Miami exercised Sandy Alcantara's option and kept him off it.

stories.title: Source: Bo Bichette to exercise $42M option to stay with Mets
stories.take: Bichette is taking the $42 million and staying in Queens — the first big domino of the hot stove falls before free agency even opens Nov. 2.

stories.title: Astros turn to Cardinals exec Randy Flores as new GM
stories.take: Houston hired Randy Flores out of the Cardinals' front office on Friday to run its baseball operations.

stories.title: Beer-fueled Brewers take to the streets to continue World Series party
stories.take: Tens of thousands packed downtown Milwaukee for the parade celebrating the franchise's first title — and the party showed no sign of stopping.

stories.title: Peralta to Chicago? Where does Skubal land? Best fits for top MLB free agents
stories.take: Free agency opens at 5 p.m. ET on Nov. 2 — ESPN maps the pairings it most wants to see as the winter gets underway.

stories.title: Rays' Wander Franco has pardon revoked, upholding conviction in sex abuse case
stories.take: A Dominican appeals court revoked Franco's pardon, leaving his conviction for sexual and psychological abuse of a minor in place.

stories.title: US approves $2.1B Patriot missile sale to Ukraine; Zelenskyy warns delivery could take years
stories.take: Washington approved 500 Patriot PAC-3 missiles for Kyiv; Zelenskyy called the decision strong but said stockpiles are needed now, not years from now.

stories.title: Candidates make final midterm stops as early voting surges
stories.take: With one weekend left, Trump reshuffled his schedule to add back rallies in Iowa and Kansas on Sunday while early voting runs hot nationwide.

stories.title: Judge orders 3 taxpayer-funded Trump administration ads pulled from TV and social media
stories.take: A federal judge found the ads looked made for political or propaganda purposes and ordered the government to take them down.

stories.title: Criminal probe underway in Alaska over would-be spoiler Senate candidate
stories.take: Alaska's top federal prosecutor confirmed a probe into claims Democrats recruited a second Dan Sullivan to confuse voters; the DOJ wants those ballots isolated.

stories.title: FBI arrests North Carolina man for allegedly posting classified information on social media
stories.take: Authorities say Army contractor James Thomas Ashbacher shared top-secret data online and stole night-vision goggles.

stories.title: US cancels G20 'family photo' after allies refuse to appear with Russia
stories.take: Marco Rubio pulled the traditional photo at the Atlanta foreign ministers' meeting after about a third of countries threatened to boycott a shot with Russia in it.

stories.title: ICE agent charged after ramming unmarked SUV into man in Texas
stories.take: Agent Mario Alberto Morales is charged with aggravated assault with a deadly weapon over the Oct. 10 Houston incident that seriously injured a man.

stories.title: Sir Patrick Stewart dies at 86
stories.take: The Shakespearean who became Jean-Luc Picard and Professor X has died at 86 — tributes ran from the stage world to Starfleet all day.

stories.title: California sisters among hundreds stranded in Asia after cruise ship halts operations over fuel costs
stories.take: About 200 passengers, including two California sisters, are stuck in Cambodia after a Florida company abruptly suspended its residential cruise ship over 'extraordinary' fuel costs.

stories.title: Boyfriend of 'SNL' writer's missing sister among two arrested on suspicion of murder
stories.take: LAPD arrested Christina Downer's actor boyfriend and one other person on suspicion of murder, nearly a year after she disappeared.

stories.title: Video shows ICE agent pointing handgun in face of North Hollywood bystander
stories.take: Footage shows agents detaining a man in North Hollywood, then pointing a handgun directly at an apparently unarmed bystander.

stories.title: How Prop. 45 could reshape California's fight over data centers
stories.take: Prop. 45 is sold as a pro-housing measure, but opponents say it could quietly make data centers easier to build across California.

stories.title: 14 California lawmakers are posting not-so-secret instructions on how to attack their opponents
stories.take: A CalMatters investigation found more than a dozen legislative candidates appear to be feeding campaign material to outside groups through 'redboxing' — coordination hiding in plain sight.

stories.title: Becerra widens lead in governor's race as voter focus shifts to Trump, new poll shows
stories.take: The latest LA Times/Berkeley poll has Becerra pulling ahead as the governor's race turns into a referendum on Trump.

stories.title: A new rainstorm moves in Friday. What it means for L.A. Halloween
stories.take: Stray showers arrive Friday with cooler-than-average highs — Halloween night in L.A. looks damp in spots, so plan the costume run accordingly.

stories.title: Intel Shares Plunge After Outlook Hit by PC Slump, Supply
stories.take: Intel fell 28% after a weak outlook: the PC slump is far worse than expected and a memory crunch — capacity diverted to data centers, memory prices nearly doubled in 18 months — is squeezing PC makers • Server CPU demand stays strong but wafer and substrate supply caps shipments; Intel still guides 2027 revenue growth on data-center AI strength • Also covered: Amazon down ~2.5% on capex fears despite healthy e-commerce, record refining results for Exxon and Chevron, and the ~$6B Binance hack attributed to North Korea

stories.title: Answering your questions before Election Day
stories.take: Can polls be trusted? National polls are “pretty darn good,” state polls are “a mess” — use long-track-record pollsters, read direction not precision (a 3-point margin of error is a 6-point range) • If Democrats take a chamber: expect oversight and investigations, not big bills — Trump would likely keep governing by executive action, and hosts urge caution on impeachment • Debates aren't dead: four Senate debates in Maine alone, and a record number predicted for the 2028 primaries • 2028 signals to watch: Ossoff's margin in Georgia, what Pritzker, Shapiro and Moore say on election night, and how fast Republicans create daylight from Trump if the night goes badly

stories.title: Instant Reaction: Wall Street Gets AI Wake-Up Call with Deep Tech Selloff
stories.take: A broad tech selloff capped the week: S&P 500 −1.8%, Nasdaq −2.9%, Dow just over −1%, with volatility spiking to the mid-20s before settling near 19 • Analysts see no single catalyst — many small factors adding up, and earnings scrutiny has shifted to cash flow and whether AI capex can be justified • Also: Apple's premium hardware push, including $2,000 foldables, in a K-shaped economy, and a look inside SpaceX's hiring culture

stories.title: Welcome to the Prediction-Market Election
stories.take: Prediction markets are a mainstream election source for the first time: Kalshi and Polymarket drew ~2.1 billion election page views and ~750 million searches, passing Gallup and Quinnipiac in brand awareness • The signal: Polymarket showed ~95 House seats flipping with a ~67% chance Democrats reach 52+ Senate seats, and NYT/Siena now publishes Kalshi odds alongside its polls; election-market volume is running ~$1B a week • Caveats: bettors skew younger, male and crypto-native, and thin markets can be moved — even a top Polymarket trader's $1.5M profit is likely mostly luck
